title: 2020 Dakar Rally
who: Won by Carlos Sainz / Lucas Cruz (Bahrain JCW X-Raid) and Ricky Brabec (Monster Energy Honda)
summary: The 2020 edition of the Dakar Rally, in its Saudi Arabia era: 11 stage towns and bivouacs through Saudi Arabia. Winners — Cars: Carlos Sainz / Lucas Cruz (Bahrain JCW X-Raid); Bikes: Ricky Brabec (Monster Energy Honda); Quads: Ignacio Casale (Casale Racing); Trucks: Andrey Karginov / Andrey Mokeev / Igor Leonov (Kamaz-Master); UTVs: Casey Currie / Sean Berriman (Monster Energy Can-Am).
approximate: Stage towns and bivouacs from Wikipedia's stage table. The rally ran off-road between them, so the lines are straight from bivouac to bivouac.
